Alistar.watch: Keep your distance from Alistar W Headbutt, since it can lead into Alistar Q Pulverize's knockup and Alistar E Trample's stun. Watch for Alistar W Headbutt's cast animation and cast Morgana E Black Shield on yourself or the ally he is targeting. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock you under it.
Alistar.fight: Close the distance and counterattack just after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. Land Morgana Q Dark Binding through an open line, then follow up with Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and wait out its duration before fighting again.
Alistar.combo: After Alistar W Headbutt is down, bind him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the chain stun lands as the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, the enemy can walk away, so don't try to engage in this order.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his only mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the distance or catch him out. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, use the window while both abilities are on cooldown to reposition or push the lane.
Alistar.teamfight: First, block engage crowd control such as Alistar W Headbutt with Morgana E Black Shield. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. Morgana R Soul Shackles is interrupted if Morgana dies before the stun lands, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass or use it after your allies have already locked down an enemy. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't focus your damage on Alistar; target the backline. If you can't disengage, interrupt his engage with Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles after he activates his ultimate.
Alistar.laning: Early on, manage your distance from Alistar W Headbutt instead of forcing a kill, and save enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield. Morgana Q Dark Binding is blocked by minions, so cast it through an open line beside the wave; hold it if the angle is uncertain. Use Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy to poke, but don't push the bot wave unnecessarily.
Alistar.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Alistar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Alistar P Triumphant Roar becomes a problem.
Alistar.phase: Early on, Morgana's lane strength depends on landing Morgana Q Dark Binding, so don't force kills. From midgame, once you have items, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Blitzcrank's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, watch for Blitzcrank's grab, and don't force a kill if there's no angle to land Morgana Q Dark Binding. From midgame, once you have items, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles. The information doesn't indicate which champion is stronger late game.
Blitzcrank.combo: When you have an opening to catch Blitzcrank, root him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the chain stun lands as the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, the enemy can walk away, so don't reverse this order.
Blitzcrank.escape: An opening to engage comes after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses. If you land Morgana Q Dark Binding through an open line then follow up with Morgana R Soul Shackles, Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is still available, save Morgana E Black Shield for that attempt.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses. Once there's an open line that minions don't block, look for Morgana Q Dark Binding, then place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target if it lands. Check whether Blitzcrank is low on mana to find a safe window to trade.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions between you and Blitzcrank, and use a Control Ward to secure vision in the brush. In bot lane, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy champion to poke, and push the wave only when leaving lane to place vision or roam. If the angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding is uncertain, don't cast it; save mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: First, protect one ally by blocking Blitzcrank's engage crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. If Morgana dies before the stun lands, the chains break, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass; if you don't have it, cast R only after your allies have already locked down an enemy.
Blitzcrank.watch: Being pulled by Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab can lead into Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Stand with a minion between you and Blitzcrank, and block the grab with Morgana E Black Shield as he attempts it. If you don't have vision in the brush, stay well away from it.

Bard.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance. If the healing from Bard W Caretaker's Shrine becomes a problem, use Morellonomicon to reduce healing.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down or you've dodged Bard Q Cosmic Binding, root him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the Morgana R Soul Shackles stun lands as the Morgana Q Dark Binding root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don't reverse the order and cast Morgana R Soul Shackles first.
Bard.escape: Bard E Magical Journey is his only escape, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the distance and catch him. Look for an engage angle after dodging Bard Q Cosmic Binding or blocking it with Morgana E Black Shield. If Bard opens a portal to escape, follow him through only if you judge it safe.
Bard.fight: Early on, first look for an open line to land Morgana Q Dark Binding; if the angle is uncertain, just poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow. Make Bard use Bard E Magical Journey, then close the distance and catch him with Morgana Q Dark Binding. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately and you can survive until the stun lands.
Bard.laning: If you see Bard W Caretaker's Shrine in lane, walk over it to remove it. Usually cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy; use it to push the wave when leaving lane to place vision or roam. Don't throw Morgana Q Dark Binding recklessly, and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Bard.phase: Early on, Morgana's kill participation is relatively low, so don't force it; look for angles to land Morgana Q Dark Binding. The provided information isn't enough to judge which champion is stronger late game.
Bard.teamfight: First, choose who to protect from Bard Q Cosmic Binding's crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Then, when your allies can follow up immediately, bind multiple enemies with Morgana R Soul Shackles and survive with Zhonya's Hourglass until the stun lands. Use Morgana Q Dark Binding to find an angle before the teamfight starts.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. When you see Bard Q Cosmic Binding's cast animation, cast Morgana E Black Shield on the target who needs it. Bard R Tempered Fate grants invulnerability in its area, so account for that effect when timing your attacks.

Brand.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand's main damage is magic, and Morgana has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, root him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the chain stun lands as the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, Brand can walk away, so don't reverse the order by casting Morgana R Soul Shackles first.
Brand.escape: Use the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame goes down as your signal to engage. Brand has no mobility ability, and Brand Q Sear won't stun if Blaze hasn't been applied.
Brand.fight: Look for Morgana Q Dark Binding when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand remains in range. If you're ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear's stun first.
Brand.laning: Brand E Conflagration can spread beside burning minions, so step aside before moving in to last-hit. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it through an open line beside the wave. In bot lane, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Brand rather than on the wave, and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield when Brand can engage.
Brand.phase: Early on, Morgana's lane results depend on landing Morgana Q Dark Binding, so don't force a kill. From midgame, once you have items, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles. The provided information isn't enough to determine which champion is stronger late game.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and have a way to survive until the stun lands.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and then explodes when you are hit by abilities in succession, so focus on dodging the first ability, Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you're ablaze, watch for the stun from Brand Q Sear; move out of the projectile's line or hide behind minions. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies.

Braum.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Braum's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Braum.combo: After Braum E Unbreakable drops, land Morgana Q Dark Binding through an angle not blocked by minions. Place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the rooted target, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles so the chain stun lands as the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don't force this kill combo.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is your window to close the distance and land Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles. When Braum's crowd control is targeting you, cast Morgana E Black Shield on yourself in time with its cast animation, then decide whether to engage.
Braum.fight: When Braum E Unbreakable is raised, don't cast Morgana Q Dark Binding straight at him. Find an angle after the shield drops or from a direction Braum isn't facing. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is your chance to engage with Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Braum.laning: Block Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions, and avoid leaving an open line facing Braum. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it only when you have an open line; if the angle is uncertain, poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, don't push the wave carelessly with Morgana W Tormented Shadow.
Braum.phase: Early on, lane strength depends on whether Morgana Q Dark Binding lands, so don't force a kill. The provided information isn't enough to judge which champion is stronger late game.
Braum.teamfight: First, block Braum's engage crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. Morgana R Soul Shackles is interrupted if Morgana dies before the stun lands, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass; if you don't have it, use R only after your allies have already locked down an enemy. Don't pour damage into the front of Braum E Unbreakable; wait for the shield to drop or for another angle to open.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or a basic attack starts stacking Braum P Concussive Blows, move out of range before the stacks are complete. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure's cast animation and dodge to the side, perpendicular to its line. Don't step on the slow zone it leaves behind.

Heimerdinger.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is magic, and Morgana has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: Against Heimerdinger, root him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the R stun lands as the Q root ends. If Q misses, Heimerdinger can walk out of R's range, so don't force an engage in this order.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so landing Morgana Q Dark Binding by going around his turret setup can give you a chance to catch him.
Heimerdinger.fight: The opening to engage comes beside a turret that has just been placed or has just finished firing a powerful shot.
Heimerdinger.laning: Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so target Heimerdinger through an open line beside the wave. If the angle is uncertain, save Q and poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Heimerdinger, while saving mana for Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, don't push the wave unnecessarily with W.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Morgana's kill participation is relatively low, so don't force a kill in front of Heimerdinger's turret setup. The provided information isn't enough to judge which champion is stronger late game.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don't group up in narrow areas. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. You need to stay alive until the stun lands after casting R, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass; if you don't have it, cast R only after your allies have already locked down an enemy.
Heimerdinger.watch: When health has been reduced, also watch out for the finishing damage from empowered Heimerdinger W Hextech Micro-Rockets.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's damage is mostly magic, and Morgana has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance and movement speed over stacking health.
Hwei.combo: After landing Morgana Q Dark Binding through a gap in the minions, place Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Hwei, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the R stun lands as the Q root ends. If Q misses, don't cast R first and chase him.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage. Catch him with Morgana Q Dark Binding, then follow up with Morgana R Soul Shackles. If E is still available, it can push back or root the engager, so check whether it's been used first.
Hwei.fight: Close the distance right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear. Find an open line to land Morgana Q Dark Binding, then cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Hwei, whose health has been reduced, to limit his room to move. If Hwei's first ability hits you, move to dodge the follow-up instead of trading in place.
Hwei.laning: Early on, look for Morgana Q Dark Binding from an angle not blocked by minions instead of forcing a kill. If the angle is uncertain, save Q and poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, but be careful not to push the wave with W in bot lane. Always save enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield against Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.phase: Early on, manage your angles for Morgana Q Dark Binding and save enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield instead of forcing kills. The provided information isn't enough to judge the champions' relative strength late game.
Hwei.teamfight: First, protect your allies' engage by blocking Hwei E Subject: Torment's crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Engage with Morgana R Soul Shackles after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and your allies can follow up immediately. If you die before the R stun lands, the chains break, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass or use R after your allies have already locked down an enemy.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you're likely to get hit by follow-up attacks, so cast Morgana E Black Shield when you see the cast animation. If the first ability hits, move immediately to avoid the second ability and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary's explosion. The eye Hwei E Subject: Torment leaves on the ground roots the first enemy who enters, so check its position before engaging.

Janna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon becomes a problem, consider Morellonomicon. When engaging with Morgana R Soul Shackles, you need Zhonya's Hourglass to survive until the stun lands.
Janna.combo: Once Janna E Eye Of The Storm's shield is down and the risk of being knocked away by Janna R Monsoon is lower, bind with Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so R's stun lands around when the Q root ends. If Q misses, don't activate R first and chase.
Janna.escape: A missed Janna Q Howling Gale or the moment after Janna uses Janna R Monsoon is your chance to close the gap. Because of the movement speed from Janna W Zephyr, don't rely on minions to block her path; hit Morgana Q Dark Binding through an open line to engage.
Janna.fight: Harass the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then focus damage into them while the shield is down. When you see the cast animation for Janna Q Howling Gale, cast Morgana E Black Shield on its target to block the knock-up. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, account for the risk of being knocked away before you go deep with Morgana R Soul Shackles.
Janna.laning: Look for Morgana Q Dark Binding from an open angle beside the wave so minions don't block it. If the angle is uncertain, hold Q and harass the enemy champion with Morgana W Tormented Shadow without needlessly pushing the bot wave. Save mana for Morgana E Black Shield to answer Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr.
Janna.phase: Early on, Morgana's laning strength depends on whether Q hits, so don't force kills. From mid game onward, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and R. The provided information isn't enough to judge which side is stronger late game.
Janna.teamfight: First, protect your allies by blocking crowd control such as Janna Q Howling Gale with Morgana E Black Shield. If Janna stays behind her allied damage dealers, your engage can be pushed back, so establish vision and look for a moment when she is separated. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately and you can survive until the stun lands.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale reaches farther and knocks enemies up longer the longer it charges, so dodge its path when you hear it charging out of vision. Janna R Monsoon knocks away enemies who engage, so don't go deep before she uses it. Janna E Eye Of The Storm grants its target a shield and increased attack damage, so don't pour damage into them while it is active.

Karma.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Karma's healing becomes a problem, use Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Karma.combo: After binding with Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target and activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so R's stun lands around when the Q root ends. If Q misses, don't activate R alone and chase.
Karma.escape: The chance to engage comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. Also make sure the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has ended.
Karma.fight: Manage your distance instead of taking Karma's harass for free. Engage after baiting out or breaking Karma W Focused Resolve, and after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has ended. If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target and follow with Morgana R Soul Shackles.
Karma.laning: Stand behind minions or outside Karma's range to reduce how often her abilities hit. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it from an open angle beside the wave. In bot lane, use Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy champion; if the angle is uncertain, hold Q and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Karma.phase: Early on, whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits determines your laning strength, so don't force kills. The information alone isn't enough to judge which side is stronger late game.
Karma.teamfight: First, protect your allies by blocking crowd control such as Karma W Focused Resolve with Morgana E Black Shield. Engage with Morgana R Soul Shackles after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has ended and when your allies can follow immediately. You must survive until R's stun lands, so endure with Zhonya's Hourglass or, if you don't have it, wait until your allies have already locked down the enemy before activating R.
Karma.watch: The area left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame detonates after a short delay, so leave it immediately if you get hit. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects to you, create distance before the root lands to break the tether. Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve heals Karma while connected, so don't stay near her for long.

Leona.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Leona's damage is mostly magic, and Morgana's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. After that, choose resistances based on the damage type of the enemy carry who can deal damage while Leona has you locked down.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, hit Morgana Q Dark Binding from an open angle, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the chain stun lands around when the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, the target can walk away, so don't start with Morgana R Soul Shackles.
Leona.escape: Right after you make Leona use her mobility tool, Leona E Zenith Blade, you have a window to close the gap and catch her. Hit Morgana Q Dark Binding then, and follow with Morgana R Soul Shackles if your allies can join immediately. If Leona's engage targets you, you can cast Morgana E Black Shield on yourself to block the crowd control, but then you won't have a shield left to protect your allied carry.
Leona.fight: Early on, rather than trading physical damage into Leona's high armor, chip away at her health and push her out of the area with Morgana W Tormented Shadow. Right after you make Leona use Leona E Zenith Blade, counterattack by binding her with Morgana Q Dark Binding. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast from an open angle beside the wave.
Leona.laning: Don't stand in line with your allied ranged carry, and don't give Leona room to engage. In bot lane, harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy champion, and use it to push the wave only when leaving lane for vision or a roam. If the angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding is uncertain, don't throw it; save mana for Morgana E Black Shield against Leona's engage.
Leona.phase: Early on, watch for Leona's chain crowd control and don't throw Morgana Q Dark Binding recklessly. From mid game, as you gain items, use Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles to initiate or end teamfights. The provided information alone isn't enough to judge which side is stronger late game.
Leona.teamfight: Your first task is to block Leona's engage crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield, followed by Morgana R Soul Shackles. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that's a signal that follow-up enemy damage is coming, so back off. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately, and endure until the stun lands with Zhonya's Hourglass.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and dashes to the last champion hit, so don't stand in a line with your ally. When you see its cast animation, use Morgana E Black Shield on its target to block the engage crowd control. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch the distance at which she can reach you rather than whether she has used the ability. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun. If Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its range before it explodes.

Lulu.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance before armor.
Lulu.combo: After hitting Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target and activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so the chain stun lands around when the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don't force this kill sequence.
Lulu.escape: The chance to close the gap comes after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is strong at countering big engages, so keep harassing with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and chipping away at her health. When the shield from Lulu E Help, Pix! and Pix go to a carry on Lulu's team, target Lulu herself with Morgana Q Dark Binding from an open path.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and cast Morgana Q Dark Binding from an angle that minions don't block. In bot lane, harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the target without needlessly pushing the wave. If the angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding is uncertain, save mana and keep some for Morgana E Black Shield.
Lulu.phase: Early on, focus on finding angles for Morgana Q Dark Binding and managing your distance rather than forcing kills. The information provided alone isn't enough to judge which side is stronger late game.
Lulu.teamfight: First, cast Morgana E Black Shield in time on the ally targeted by the enemy's engage crowd control, then look for a chance to use Morgana R Soul Shackles. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don't expect to secure a guaranteed kill on the protected target; look for Lulu herself or another target. You must survive until Morgana R Soul Shackles stuns, so endure with Zhonya's Hourglass or activate it after your allies have already locked down the enemy.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy interrupts engages with silence and a slow, so don't approach recklessly while it is available. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so check whether she has used it before going deep on that target. Cast Morgana E Black Shield when Lulu Q Glitterlance's slow or an effect that stops an engage is aimed at you or an ally.

Lux.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux's damage is mostly magic, and Morgana's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, root her with Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Lux, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time it so R's stun lands around when the Q root ends. If Q misses, don't activate R first and chase.
Lux.escape: The chance to go in comes right after you dodge Lux Q Light Binding or block it with Morgana E Black Shield. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so close the gap from the side and catch her with Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then create an angle to cast Morgana Q Dark Binding from the side or a bush. Lux has no mobility ability, so she's easy to catch if you close the gap and land a root. If a Lux ability hits you and applies Illumination, leave her basic attack range to avoid the extra damage.
Lux.laning: Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so target Lux from an open angle beside the wave. In bot lane, harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Lux, and don't needlessly push the wave unless you're about to leave lane. If the Q angle is uncertain, don't throw it; save mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Lux.phase: Early on, Morgana's laning strength depends on whether Q hits, so don't force kills. The information provided alone isn't enough to judge which side is stronger late game.
Lux.teamfight: First, cast Morgana E Black Shield in time with the cast animation on the target of Lux Q Light Binding. Approach while spreading out from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn't hold you up together, and activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately. If you die before R's stun lands, the chains break, so endure with Zhonya's Hourglass or use R after your allies have locked down the enemy.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits, her follow-up abilities are likely to hit too, so dodge when you see its cast animation or cast Morgana E Black Shield at that moment. Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don't stand in a line with your ally. When your health is low and you see the targeting line for Lux R Final Spark, move sideways. If a Lux ability hits you, don't stay within her basic attack range while marked with Illumination.

Maokai.build: Build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots early. After that, choose resistances based on the enemy carry who can deal damage while Maokai has you locked down. If healing from Maokai P Sap Magic becomes a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down and his dash ends, root him with Morgana Q Dark Binding. Then cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him and activate Morgana R Soul Shackles, timing it so the stun lands around when the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don't force this kill sequence.
Maokai.escape: The moment after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance is your window to go in. Catch him with Morgana Q Dark Binding then, and follow with Morgana R Soul Shackles if your allies can join immediately. Keep your distance first while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready.
Maokai.fight: Close the gap and trade damage right after Maokai is made to waste Maokai W Twisted Advance. Don't waste abilities on Maokai while he's dashing; look for Morgana Q Dark Binding after he lands. To avoid making the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic available again too frequently, use your usual harass abilities on the enemy carry.
Maokai.laning: Keep your distance near bushes while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it when an open angle appears beside the wave. In bot lane, use Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy champion and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield in case of an engage.
Maokai.phase: Early on, laning strength depends heavily on whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, so don't force kills. From mid game onward, use Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles to decide when to engage or counter-engage in teamfights. The information provided alone isn't enough to conclude which side is stronger late game.
Maokai.teamfight: First, use Morgana E Black Shield in time against crowd control targeting an ally, such as Maokai W Twisted Advance. Avoid narrow paths where Maokai R Nature's Grasp is coming, and dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel in open terrain. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately. You must survive until the stun lands, so if you don't have Zhonya's Hourglass, use R after your allies have locked down the enemy.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, so when you see its cast animation, cast Morgana E Black Shield on its target. Don't enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss is placed, and if Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from a distance, dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.

When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, close the gap and target Milio. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately and you can survive until the stun lands.

If the angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding is uncertain, don't throw it; save mana for Morgana E Black Shield.

Milio has no mobility ability and low defensive stats, so taking him out first can reduce the enemy composition's sustain. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately, and endure until the stun lands with Zhonya's Hourglass.

If you approach Nami, catch her with Morgana Q Dark Binding; she has no mobility ability.

Keep your distance from a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, then close in again when it expires. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately and you can survive until the stun lands.

If the angle is uncertain, don't throw Q repeatedly; harass Nami with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, don't needlessly push by casting W on the wave.

Nami.teamfight: First, cast Morgana E Black Shield in time with the cast animation on an ally targeted by Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. Then bind multiple enemies with Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow immediately. If you die before R's stun lands, the chains break, so endure with Zhonya's Hourglass; if you don't have it, activate R after your allies have locked down the enemy.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, so dodge sideways when you see its falling indicator. If it's hard to dodge, cast Morgana E Black Shield in time with the cast animation. Nami R Tidal Wave comes from far away but travels slowly, so move sideways when you see it and watch for Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Don't fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; fight after the effect ends.

If you're the target of the engage, cast Morgana E Black Shield on yourself to buy time to activate Morgana R Soul Shackles.

If the angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding is uncertain, save mana and keep enough for Morgana E Black Shield in case of an engage.
Nautilus.phase: In the early game, whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits determines your lane strength. Focus on managing your distance to avoid Nautilus's chain crowd control. The information provided isn't enough to judge the relative strengths in the late game.

Don't stand in line with your allies along Nautilus R Depth Charge's path. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. If Morgana dies before the stun triggers, R ends, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass or, if you don't have that option, use R after your allies have already caught the opponent.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so keep your distance with minions between you. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack, so stay out of basic attack range. If Nautilus uses E Riptide right beside you, stay in place until the waves end. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in line with your allies along its path.

If the angle is uncertain, save mana so you can afford Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under your opponent's feet so you don't push the wave unnecessarily.

Pantheon.teamfight: Then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and survive until the stun triggers with Zhonya's Hourglass. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait to attack from the front or deal damage from the side.

Pyke.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Prioritize armor against Pyke's damage, then build health to stay above Pyke R Death From Below's threshold. If Pyke's healing becomes a problem, build Morellonomicon.

Time it so R's stun triggers around when Q's root ends. You must stay alive until the stun triggers after activating R, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass.

Before Pyke R Death From Below is available again, link Morgana Q Dark Binding into Morgana R Soul Shackles to limit his chance to escape.
Pyke.fight: Wait to see Pyke Q Bone Skewer's pull before using Morgana E Black Shield; don't use the shield beforehand. If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, aim Morgana Q Dark Binding at the spot where Pyke remains. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don't force an engage with Morgana R Soul Shackles.
Pyke.laning: Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it through an open lane beside the wave. If you don't have an angle, save Q and harass the enemy champion with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, keeping enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield. After a trade, if Pyke backs off, maintain vision to deny healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.phase: In the early game, lane strength depends on whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, so don't force kills. From the mid game onward, focus on starting teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and Morgana R Soul Shackles. In the late game, move with your squishy allies behind the frontline so Pyke can't pick them off as easily.
Pyke.teamfight: First, protect your allies by blocking Pyke's engage crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can join immediately and you can survive until the stun triggers. Don't stand near low-health allies within range of Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you and Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns you, you're vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so keep your distance. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, dodge to the side of its dash path. If you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, retreat toward your allies or turret.

Rakan.build: Survive with Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Build magic resistance first to match Rakan's damage, but prioritize tools for handling crowd control over additional resistance.

If the angle is uncertain, save Q and harass champions with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, keeping enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield against Rakan's engage. In bot lane, don't use W to push the wave unless you're leaving lane for vision or a roam.
Rakan.phase: In the early game, whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits determines your lane strength, so don't force kills. The information provided isn't enough to judge which side is stronger in the late game.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance has a visible landing point, so sidestep when the dash starts. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so put terrain between you or stop him with Morgana Q Dark Binding before he reaches you. Don't stand in a line with your allies.

Rell.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rell's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity is also important because her crowd control can lead to follow-up hits.

Time them so R's stun triggers around when the root ends. If Q misses, Rell can walk out of R's range, so don't reverse the order.

Rell.phase: In the early game, watch for Rell's engage and don't force kills. From the mid game onward, affect teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and R. The information provided isn't enough to determine which side is stronger in the late game.

When you see engage crowd control such as Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, cast Morgana E Black Shield on the target who needs it. Then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and survive until the stun triggers with Zhonya's Hourglass.

If Rell and an ally both speed up, that's a sign Rell E Full Tilt is active; stop trading and back off. Renata.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Renata Glasc's damage is mostly magic and Morgana has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Time them so the chain stun triggers around when the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, Renata Glasc can walk away, so don't start with Morgana R Soul Shackles.

Renata Glasc has no built-in mobility, so you can catch her by hitting Morgana Q Dark Binding then. If you have to engage while her crowd control is available, watch for the casting animation and cast Morgana E Black Shield.

Harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, and close the distance if Morgana Q Dark Binding hits through a line that minions don't block. Morgana R Soul Shackles requires you to survive until the stun, so activate it when your allies can follow up immediately.

Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it through an open lane beside the wave. If the angle is uncertain, save mana. Harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the opponent's feet without pushing the wave unnecessarily, and save enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Renata.phase: Renata Glasc has low base health and attack damage early, but it's also hard for Morgana to force a kill if Morgana Q Dark Binding misses. The information provided isn't enough to judge which side is stronger in the late game.

First, block Renata Glasc's crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. After activating Morgana R Soul Shackles, you must stay alive until the stun triggers, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass.

Engage after Senna W Last Embrace is blocked by a minion or by Morgana E Black Shield. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, camouflaged enemies can approach, so don't engage from that spot; retreat to an area with vision.

Block Senna W Last Embrace's root with Morgana E Black Shield in time with its casting animation, and back off to avoid a second attack if Senna hits you once. If Q hits and your allies can follow up immediately, close the distance and chain into Morgana R Soul Shackles.

Harass with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Senna's feet without pushing the bot wave unnecessarily, and save enough mana for Morgana E Black Shield.

As the game goes late, Senna's range and attack damage grow as she collects souls, so disrupt her collection from the early game.
Senna.teamfight: Use Morgana R Soul Shackles to lock down multiple enemies when your allies can follow up immediately and you can stay alive until the stun triggers.

If Senna W Last Embrace marks you, move away from allies before the root triggers; before it hits, stand behind minions. If Senna hits you once, retreat immediately so she can't land a second attack and collect Mist.

If the angle is unclear, save Q and poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, casting it under the enemy champion so you don’t push the bot wave. Save mana for Morgana E Black Shield to answer Seraphine E Beat Drop.

First block Seraphine’s crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. You need to survive until R’s stun triggers, so use Zhonya’s Hourglass to endure; if you don’t have it, wait until your allies have caught an enemy before activating R.

If you are slowed, move out of the direct line, and cast Morgana E Black Shield when you see Seraphine E Beat Drop’s cast animation. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don’t stand in a line.

Overlap the timing so the chain’s stun triggers around when the root ends. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, Sona can walk away, so don’t start with Morgana R Soul Shackles.

If Sona R Crescendo is already down, you can approach without worrying about its stun. If she still has Sona R Crescendo, be ready to cast Morgana E Black Shield when you see its cast animation.

Cast Morgana Q Dark Binding along an open line beside the wave where minions won’t block it. If the angle is unclear, poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and save mana for Morgana E Black Shield in preparation for an engage. Overlap the timing so R’s stun triggers around when Q’s root ends. If Q misses, Soraka can walk out of R’s range, so don’t reverse the order.

Soraka has no mobility skill, but hitting Soraka Q Starcall grants her movement speed, so dodge Q while closing the distance. Use Morgana Q Dark Binding before stepping into Soraka E Equinox’s zone, and answer it with Morgana E Black Shield when it comes back up.

Soraka has no mobility skill, so land Morgana Q Dark Binding along an open line, then deal your damage in a short burst.

Instead of continually hitting enemies who are being healed, catch Soraka herself, since she has no mobility skill, and focus your damage in a short burst. Morgana R Soul Shackles is interrupted if you die before the stun triggers, so activate it when your allies can follow up immediately and use Zhonya’s Hourglass to survive until the stun if needed.

Soraka E Equinox’s silence and root are dangerous, so use your engage skill before entering its zone; if you see its cast animation, block the crowd control with Morgana E Black Shield. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so account for it when fighting in other lanes too.

Overlap the timing so R’s stun triggers around when Q’s root ends. If Q misses, Taric can walk out of R’s range, so don’t reverse the order.

If you keep Taric away from the target he wants to basic attack, you can also slow how quickly he cycles his skills with Taric P Bravado. Deal damage again as Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so look for an angle along an open line beside the wave. In bot lane, poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy, and push the wave only when leaving lane to ward or roam. If the Q angle is unclear, save mana; when Taric can engage, keep mana for Morgana E Black Shield.
Taric.phase: Early on, watch out for Taric P Bravado’s close-range damage, and have Morgana poke from a distance instead of forcing a kill. In the midgame, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and R; the given information isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage late.
Taric.teamfight: First cast Morgana E Black Shield in time on the ally targeted by Taric E Dazzle to block the stun. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, catch enemies with Morgana Q Dark Binding and R Soul Shackles so your allies can deal damage when the immunity ends. You need to survive until R’s stun triggers, so endure with Zhonya’s Hourglass or activate R after your allies have already caught an enemy.
Taric.watch: When you see Taric E Dazzle’s tell, dodge to the side; if it’s hard to avoid, block the stun with Morgana E Black Shield. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, don’t unload your damage; manage crowd control and positioning until it ends.

Thresh.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Thresh’s damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance, but prioritize Tenacity because Morgana has no skill to escape on her own and is easy to catch.
Thresh.combo: After Thresh W Dark Passage is down, land Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Overlap the timing so R’s stun triggers around when Q’s root ends. If Q misses, Thresh can walk out of R’s range, so don’t reverse the order.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the distance, but don’t go deep immediately if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available. Engage especially when you can land Morgana Q Dark Binding and R Soul Shackles before W comes back up.
Thresh.fight: Trade when Thresh walks forward to collect souls. Close the distance right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, and catch him with Morgana Q Dark Binding when Thresh W Dark Passage is also down. Morgana’s damage is mainly magic, and Thresh has relatively low magic resistance, so your hits deal good damage.
Thresh.laning: Look for an angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding along a line minions don’t block, such as beside the wave. If the angle is unclear, save Q and poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, but don’t push the bot wave unnecessarily. Save mana for Morgana E Black Shield when Thresh can engage.
Thresh.phase: Early Morgana’s lane strength depends on landing Morgana Q Dark Binding, so don’t force a kill. Once you have some items in the midgame, contribute to teamfights with Morgana E Black Shield and R Soul Shackles; the given information isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage late.
Thresh.teamfight: First, watch for an engage started with Thresh Q Death Sentence or E Flay and protect the targeted ally with Morgana E Black Shield. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and use Zhonya’s Hourglass if needed to survive until the stun triggers. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, either finish off the target immediately or retreat; if you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, quickly choose a direction to break out.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence has a long cast animation before its stun and dash, so move sideways as he raises his hook, and change direction again when stepping forward for the last hit. Avoid the line connecting Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you in. If he starts an engage with Q or E, cast Morgana E Black Shield at the moment he casts the ability to block the crowd control.

Velkoz.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Vel’Koz’s main damage, but Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray deal true damage that resistance can’t block, so avoiding successive hits is the priority.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down and you have an angle for Morgana Q Dark Binding, root him with Q, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Overlap the timing so R’s stun triggers around when Q’s root ends. After activating R, you must survive until the stun triggers, so use Zhonya’s Hourglass or activate it when your allies have already caught him.
Velkoz.escape: Vel’Koz has no mobility skill, so after Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down is your chance to close the distance. However, E can knock you back if you get very close, so look for an angle to finish him off with Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles before engaging.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, look for Morgana Q Dark Binding along a line minions don’t block. If Morgana Q Dark Binding misses, don’t chase recklessly with Morgana R Soul Shackles.
Velkoz.laning: Early on, don’t force a kill; create an open line for Morgana Q Dark Binding beside the wave or in a jungle entrance. If the angle is unclear, save Q and poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow, but don’t push the bot wave unnecessarily. Save mana for Morgana E Black Shield to answer Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Velkoz.phase: Early Morgana’s lane strength depends on landing Morgana Q Dark Binding, so don’t force a kill. Once you have some items in the midgame, use Morgana E Black Shield and R to start and end teamfights, and center your play around these two skills in late-game fights too.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission splits into two bolts even if you dodge the main projectile, so don’t only dodge sideways; move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the bolts passed. When you see the cast animation for Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, block the knockup with Morgana E Black Shield. If successive hits build stacks of Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction, back away and let the stacks expire. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with Morgana Q Dark Binding.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Xerath’s damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: After landing Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under Xerath, then activate Morgana R Soul Shackles. Overlap the timing so the chain’s stun triggers around when the root ends, and don’t force this engage sequence if Q misses.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility skill, so right after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and E Shocking Orb are down is your window to engage. Especially if you blocked the stun with Morgana E Black Shield after seeing E’s cast animation, close the distance and look for Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance while dodging to the side as Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse. Right after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and E Shocking Orb are down, look for Morgana Q Dark Binding along a line minions don’t block.
Xerath.laning: Early on, farm while avoiding heavy damage instead of forcing a kill, then push the wave and call your jungler when Xerath has spent a lot of mana. Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so cast it along an open line beside the wave; if the angle is unclear, save it and keep mana for Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the enemy so you don’t push the wave unnecessarily.
Xerath.phase: Early on, respect Xerath’s long range and survive while avoiding heavy damage. The given information isn’t enough to judge which champion has the advantage late.
Xerath.teamfight: First choose whom to protect from Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun with Morgana E Black Shield. Activate Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and use Zhonya’s Hourglass to endure until the stun triggers. If you don’t have Zhonya’s Hourglass, activate R after your allies have already caught an enemy.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change your direction and move to the side. If you’re stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, follow-up attacks are likely, so cast Morgana E Black Shield when you see its cast animation. When Xerath R Rite of the Arcane appears, dodge immediately or, if you can engage, target Xerath while he can’t move.

Zilean.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Zilean's damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity has a more immediate impact against the damage that follows bomb stuns and slows. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Zilean R Chronoshift becomes a problem.
Zilean.combo: Against Zilean, use Morgana Q Dark Binding → Morgana W Tormented Shadow under him → Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time the chain stun to land as the root is about to end. If you miss the root, Zilean can walk away, so don't reverse the order by starting with your ultimate.
Zilean.escape: Avoid the stun caused by two successive Zilean Q Time Bombs, then close the distance to engage. If Zilean E Time Warp has already been used on one person, engage together from another direction so you aren't all caught at once. Zilean has no mobility spell, so once you get close, you'll have a chance to catch him with Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Zilean.fight: Create an open line for Morgana Q Dark Binding to hit, then cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under the rooted Zilean to deal damage. Zilean has no mobility spell, so the moment you land a root after closing the distance is your chance to engage. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately and you can survive until the stun lands.
Zilean.laning: In bot lane, don't recklessly push the wave with Morgana W Tormented Shadow; save enough mana to cast Morgana E Black Shield.
Zilean.phase: The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Zilean.teamfight: Cast Morgana E Black Shield in time on an ally about to be stunned by Zilean Q Time Bomb or slowed by Zilean E Time Warp. Then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately, and use Zhonya's Hourglass to survive until the stun lands. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy carry, switch your target to Zilean himself, and don't waste abilities on a target being revived.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach, so move away from allies as soon as the first bomb attaches and get outside the blast radius. Cast Morgana E Black Shield just before the second bomb or Zilean E Time Warp catches you.

Zyra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Morgana's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Zyra.combo: After Zyra E Grasping Roots has been used, root her with Morgana Q Dark Binding, cast Morgana W Tormented Shadow under her, then cast Morgana R Soul Shackles. Time R so its stun lands as the Q root is about to end. If you miss Q, Zyra can walk out of R's range, so don't reverse the order.
Zyra.escape: The moment Zyra E Grasping Roots misses is your chance to engage. Zyra has no mobility spell and no way to create distance on her own, so approach from the side without plants and catch her with Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways to bait it out, then close the distance where there are no plants. Zyra has no way to escape on her own, so if Morgana Q Dark Binding hits along an open line, follow up with Morgana W Tormented Shadow for more damage. Briefly back off where many plants have been placed.
Zyra.laning: Minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding, so line up a shot through an open lane beside the wave. If the angle isn't clear, don't throw Q repeatedly; poke with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and save enough mana to cast Morgana E Black Shield. In bot lane, don't recklessly push the wave with W; cast it under the enemy.
Zyra.phase: In the early game, whether Morgana Q Dark Binding hits determines the strength of the lane, so don't force a kill. The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid places where Zyra has had time to set up seeds and plants, and move the fight elsewhere. First, block her engage crowd control, such as Zyra E Grasping Roots, with Morgana E Black Shield. Cast Morgana R Soul Shackles when your allies can follow up immediately. If you die before R's stun lands, the chains break, so survive with Zhonya's Hourglass; if you don't have it, cast R after your allies have caught an enemy.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, plant damage and the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns can follow, so dodge E by moving sideways at the edge of its range. Cast Morgana E Black Shield when E is flying toward you or an ally. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area.
